description:
An excellent opportunity to acquire this attractive two-bedroom terraced home, ideally situated in a popular residential area of Preston. Offering spacious accommodation throughout, two generous reception rooms and excellent access to local schools, amenities and transport links, this property is perfectly suited to first-time buyers, owner-occupiers and investors alike. The property is currently tenanted, providing an immediate rental income opportunity for landlords, whilst also being available with vacant possession if required.

Upon entering, you are welcomed by a vestibule leading into a spacious entrance hallway, providing access to the ground floor accommodation and staircase to the first floor. To the front of the property, the inviting lounge offers a comfortable setting for everyday living, while the second, larger reception room provides a versatile space ideal for dining, entertaining or use as an additional family room. A useful under-stairs storage cupboard further enhances the practicality of the ground floor layout.

To the rear, the well-proportioned kitchen has been thoughtfully designed to maximise both storage and workspace, with ample natural light creating a bright and welcoming environment. The kitchen also enjoys views over the enclosed rear yard.

To the first floor, the property offers two generously sized bedrooms and a family bathroom. The spacious master bedroom is situated to the rear of the property, providing a peaceful retreat with plenty of space for freestanding furniture. The second bedroom is located at the front of the home and is a well-proportioned room, ideal as a guest bedroom, childrens room or home office.

Completing the accommodation is the sizeable family bathroom, fitted with a bath and overhead shower.

Offering spacious living accommodation, excellent versatility and the flexibility to be purchased as either an investment property or owner-occupied home, this fantastic property presents an opportunity not to be missed.

This is a freehold property.

Council tax band- A

EPC rating- D

For all viewings please call to arrange.

Please contact Kingswood.
